name: Forest bamboo shoot
summary: Forest bamboo shoot is on the Bản Đôn list. VnExpress says the spring shoot is bitter at first and sweet after. Dried shoot and bitter shoot keep their own names.
origin: The Thanh Hoa Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism lists măng rừng at Bản Đôn. VnExpress, Xuân Mạnh, 3 Jul 2023, describes the fresh shoot. Măng khô and măng đắng are not this plate.
taste: VnExpress says the boiled shoot is bitter at first, then leaves a clean sweet aftertaste.
howToEat: Boiled, on the 3 Jul 2023 account. That account also says Thai cooks make măng chua from the shoot to eat through the year, with fish soup. Măng chua is its own name.
A Bản Đôn recipe was not printed. Check on arrival.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The stilt-house meal at Bản Đôn, and the spring forest on the VnExpress account.
